biggest_catch: Requires caregiving experience or certification in most markets — and a two-shift weekly commitment with the same clients.
catches: In select markets, requires 6 months of paid caregiving experience or CNA/HHA/LVN/RN certification.
Must be willing to work at least two weekly shifts with the same client(s) for consistent care.
Serves only select metro areas across 15 states — not nationwide.
Pay rates vary by market; nothing guaranteed.

notes: Scenario: in-home senior caregiving. Honor hires Care Professionals as employees (weekly direct deposit, health/dental, 401k, paid training, 1.5x holiday pay). Shifts are scheduled with the same clients for consistent care across 15 states' metro areas. Pay varies by market — variable, never guaranteed.
